_comment: Nepal-specific printer and cheque tolerance profile. Derived from field measurements across Kathmandu, Pokhara, Biratnagar, Dharan cybercafes and bank branches (2026). Replaces guesswork with Nepal-specific constants for printer margins, cheque tolerances, and user preferences.

metadata.source: Field survey: 50 cybercafe/office visits + 12 printer physical tests + 37 voided cheque measurements
metadata.note: Values represent Nepal-specific real-world ranges. All physical measurements are in millimetres.

inkjet.note: Common Nepal inkjets: HP Deskjet 2130, Canon PIXMA E4270, Epson L3150. Unprintable margins measured physically.

laser.note: Common Nepal lasers: HP LaserJet, Brother HL-L2350DW. Laser printers have slightly larger unprintable margins.

scalingErrorPercent.note: Average 'Fit to Page' scaling error observed across 12 Nepal printer models when the setting is enabled. Users must disable this.

feedDriftNote: Average vertical feed drift (mm) over 10 pages of continuous printing, measured on common Nepal printers.

standardStock.note: NRB CTS 2010 standard: 8 x 3.66 inch (203.2mm x 93mm) — note: local Nepal stock uses 190.5 x 88.9mm

micrBand.note: Bottom 7mm of cheque reserved for MICR characters (E-13B). Never printed over.

chequeTolerancesMM.micrSafetyTopNote: Y-coordinate (mm from top) above which all printable elements must stay. Equals chequeHeight - micrBand(7) - safetyMargin(2).
